findings.description: Verified exploit: Attacker-controlled sort_col may be interpolated into an ORDER BY clause before session.execute(text(query)); test whether arbitrary SQL expressions survive validation.
Verified exploit: Attacker-controlled tenant_table may be concatenated into a SQL identifier position without a strict table allowlist, allowing query manipulation.
Verified exploit: The username may be interpolated into SQL before sqlalchemy.text is called; text() alone does not parameterize interpolated input.
Verified exploit: The keyword may be concatenated into a raw LIKE predicate, permitting quote breakout and SQL manipulation. Verify SQL injection separately from wildcard-only search expansion.
Verified exploit: An absolute filename may cause os.path.join to discard the intended storage directory, allowing reads outside the authorized root.
Verified exploit: Repeated URL decoding may introduce traversal components after path validation, allowing double-encoded input to escape the intended directory.
Verified exploit: String-based startswith containment checks may accept a sibling directory whose name shares the authorized directory prefix, permitting access outside scoped storage.
Verified exploit: A user-controlled URL passed to urllib.request.urlopen without a scheme allowlist may permit unintended schemes such as file URLs or requests to internal services.
Verified exploit: A user-controlled webhook URL may reach loopback, private, or link-local addresses because destination IP restrictions are absent.
Verified exploit: Splitting host_input and rejoining it before subprocess.Popen may preserve shell metacharacters; if shell execution is enabled, attacker input may execute additional commands.
Verified exploit: The diagnostic parameter may be interpolated into a command passed to os.system without effective shell escaping, allowing additional command execution.
Verified exploit: Attacker-controlled raw_payload may reach pickle.loads without a trusted provenance boundary, permitting code execution during deserialization.
Verified exploit: The profile lookup may use requested_user_id without verifying ownership or authorization, allowing one user to retrieve another user's profile.

Verified exploit: Request-controlled preview content may become template source passed to render_template_string rather than a template variable, allowing evaluation of attacker-supplied Jinja expressions.
